H-GUIBYAPP: the application creates the GUI, the lab's bring-up no longer does (two GUIs held OSD layer 1's second buffer, the EVF lost its information every other frame); S-GUIOUT, S-ROOTLAYOUT and the EVF-start H-CONNECT removed; A19 for the EVF channel with nearest-neighbour scaling (docs/om1-shutter-spec.md item 59)

S-LENS mounts a filled 12-40mm F2.8 record and S-EXPOSE runs the firmware's exposure plan (take_expose_calculate 0x50597e82) on the scene's BV after the application starts and after each input: every play session's screen shows the planned shutter, aperture and ISO (shutter spec section 7 item 60)

the multi-model plan's changes to E143's runs (screen unchanged everywhere): S-DISPSTART runs the DISPLAY task's start-up once, as its entry does (D): interrupts present 373 ns earlier per skipped call, errlog 0x1c005002 and hook counters fall, checks re-pinned; S-RVSTANDBY stores RecView's standby word before the start: interrupt times move by 2-30 ns and the Player status lists it, the replayed outcomes otherwise equal (X); S-DISPSYNC adds hook stops; K-CRT-134D returns the SCPU counter (harness only); check_menu keeps prop_device; check_perf P10b fails as recorded (no frame checked)

the replayed scenarios run from their inputs alone (emu/scenarios/calls; osd's generated from check_osd): the output layer no longer counts the old lab's outcomes the replay does not reproduce, osd's now carries its calls' outcome digests and play-perf's the workload digest; screen, devices, stops and harness unchanged

QEMU/oracle names removed: the trap-line prefix is om-emu:, check outputs say mutant / one-insn / no child, the refused --qemu, --oracle, --regen and --respec options and the nd128 report's qemu_* fields are gone
errors and process conventions: usage errors as 'PROG: message' plus the usage line (checks/lib/args.mjs), uncaught errors as their stack (no Python traceback)
check_perf's play workload runs with --a15 auto: since every play session runs the camera application, --a15 off refused every frame and P10b failed (recorded as rc 1)

check_perf P10a and P10b say what they compare (the pinned outcome; default, one-insn and sliced) instead of naming knobs emu never read

S-SCPU answers the SCPU requests at the request API 0x5005cd17 and calls their completions natively (hle-gaps.md 4.7.1, D), replacing S-SCPU-MSG; the API's 36-byte messages are no longer allocated (heap pointers 0x90 lower: final registers, step records, heap top), the OlyEvWt router is no longer wrapped (hook names), the 0x86 reply is the word the 0x06 wrote (1c020080), S-SCPU is listed in the stand-ins, check_perf P6 counts 125,979,479 instructions and check_nav checks the ticking clock; no screen changed

UI_IN's group 0 (power lever, Fn lever, S1) reaches UI_IN through the SCPU interface's port and event words and IRQ 320 natively (hle-gaps.md 4.7.2, D: the SCPU init's attach, the IRQ 320 handler, UI_IN's callback and its old-state init), in place of S-KEYBITS for group 0 (H-SCPUIRQ, H-UIINPORT, H-SCPUPORT). No screen changes. Devices: only in the four sessions with a group-0 input (inputs, keys, power, power-replay): one accepted IRQ 320 row per input and the controller's presented/accepted counters one higher; every other row and the final registers equal. Output: only the harness counters the replayed outcomes carry (per-step hook-stop and stand-in counts: the bring-up no longer pushes group 0 and a group-0 input is a doorbell store and a native IRQ instead of a push call and set_flg; harness_entries; the stand-in list gains H-SCPUIRQ, H-UIINPORT, H-SCPUPORT) and check_perf P10b's play-workload register digest and instruction count (159,897,385 -> 159,893,967), not pinned.

The accelerometer at its sample cache (hle-gaps.md 4.7.3, D: the ACC module init, ACC_MAIN, its probe, the sampler's completion stores, the cache copy and correction, PER_SLOPE and the gauge's getter): every play session's bring-up runs the ACC module init natively with its device part stepped over (H-ACCINIT), the probe through the register file S-ACCREG, one primed copy and correction, and PER_SLOPE's init (H-SLOPEINIT); ACC_MAIN then runs its 80 ms cycle with one sample per cycle (S-ACCSAMPLE: the level camera, the firmware's pose-0 reference) and PER_SLOPE its 20 ms loop once the application's startLevel has started it. No screen changes (all 28 changed sessions are the play sessions plus check_perf's two runs). Devices: no IRQ or inter-CPU doorbell row added or removed; the rows' instruction stamps shift by the added instructions (2889 at the first IRQ row); the lab stub's ring has five more entries, the probe's last call 0x50051a7d(129) enabling the data-ready pin's GIO interrupt (words 0x9b883080 / 0x9b8831c0), and final.devices' stub log_total is five higher. Stops and harness: the new hooks (S-ACCREG, S-ACCSAMPLE, the H-ACCINIT call skip, S-HEAP pool get/release) and the extra task wake-ups. Output: the replayed outcomes' step records (per-step stand-in and hook counts, hook_stops, the stand-in list with H-ACCINIT, S-ACCREG, S-ACCSAMPLE, H-SLOPEINIT, A-ACC-1..3) and check_perf P10b's unpinned play-workload digest (159,893,967 -> 160,294,888 instructions); P6 unchanged. New runs: run/level, run/level-mutants, run/level-l3, run/level-usage (checks/check_level.mjs). WORKLOAD_DIGEST re-pinned 59e15f337f58cf57 -> 0a8f94603ae67b51: frames, lab time and hook-log length identical, the last 2000 hook-log entries hold the new hooks.

S-CARD's card is in slot 1's detect state: the card driver's detect state of drive 0 is 2, inserted (src/fw/facts.mjs cardDetect, D: the drive status 0x508a8327 sets its card-present bit 0x80 for state 2 or 3, read by 0x5087bc22 from 0xa33af3d4), so the media control reports the slot present (getMediaStateInfo +4) and the GUI's shooting-screen count updater (0x511ff915, its gate 0x5120054d) draws the slot icon and S-CARD's 999 shots: the TFT's top bar shows '1 999' at 236,4-353,33 and the EVF's '1 999' at 1432,1094-1597,1195 where an orange 0 stood (X: every compose of the changed sessions rendered with and without the state, the only differing boxes; the final composites of the SCP, menu, playback, queue, power and inputs sessions identical, their plane memory and OSD drawing differing)
